0022600188.text: The Golden State Warriors, 5-3 and riding a five-game winning streak, host the Miami Heat, who are 2-5 and coming off a loss, in a game that is the Warriors' ninth of the season. Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 7th in the West, while Miami is 4th in the Southeast, two games back, and 10th in the East. The Warriors will be without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and the teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1 before the Warriors won 135-112 in San Francisco on January 19, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
